items.title: Rappler’s Gelo Gonzales named 2026 East-West Center Jefferson Fellow
items.description: The three-week fellowship will bring journalists to Honolulu, Tokyo, and Seoul to examine artificial intelligence’s impact on societies and economic security in the Asia-Pacific region

items.title: Filipino composer Rom Dongeto and the song we thought we knew
items.description: Decades after a TV commercial propelled it into the mainstream, the activist-born anthem ‘Kanlungan’ — popularized by the voice of Noel Cabangon — continues to transcend generations as a bittersweet classic, though few realize it was composed by Rom Dongeto

items.title: Lawmaker seeks Chinese envoy’s expulsion over embassy’s ‘stop bluffing’ taunt
items.description: A lawmaker called for the expulsion of Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan after the Chinese Embassy in Manila dared Philippine officials pushing to declare him persona non grata to “STOP BLUFFING.”

items.title: As Asia grays, can an aging Philippines avoid its neighbors’ fate?
items.description: As the share of older Filipinos grows and fewer babies are born, the urgency to prepare rises

items.title: Chemical spill may have triggered MV June Aster fire — BFP
items.description: The Bureau of Fire Protection is investigating how calcium hypochlorite and asphalt allegedly spilled and mixed aboard passenger and cargo vessel MV June Aster, possibly triggering a fire that killed 77 people off Coron, Palawan.

items.description: The choose-your-own-adventure format of ‘Gen G’ forces the audience to stay fully immersed in the story, with the active, live-voting feature directly dictating the fate of the characters

items.description: A six-time NBA All-Star, Amar'e Stoudemire fulfills a ‘childhood dream’ to serve in law enforcement

items.title: JBC to interview 5 candidates for chief justice post
items.description: The Judicial and Bar Council will interview five candidates for the position of chief justice on October 22 and 26 ahead of Chief Justice Alexander Gesmundo's compulsory retirement.

items.title: ICC prosecutors seek to present 5 witnesses' prior testimonies in Duterte case
items.description: Prosecutors at the International Criminal Court have asked judges to admit the recorded testimonies of five witnesses in the crimes against humanity of murder case against former president Rodrigo Duterte, saying their accounts could help establish an alleged policy of killing suspected criminals.

items.title: Super typhoon may enter PAR next week
items.description: A potential super typhoon is expected to enter the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) next week, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration said yesterday.

items.title: Philippine removes 250,000 fake overseas job posts
items.description: The Philippines has worked with social media platforms Meta and TikTok to remove about 250,000 online posts advertising fraudulent overseas jobs, the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) said.

items.title: Zaldy Co’s bagmen, Baligod arrested for unjust vexation
items.description: Fourteen alleged bagmen of ex-lawmaker Zaldy Co and their lawyer Levi Baligod have been ordered arrested yet again, this time by a Zambales court for unjust vexation.

items.title: Ombudsman: Plunder cases vs Legarda, Leviste filed soon
items.description: A plunder case against Sen. Loren Legarda and her son, Batangas Rep. Leandro Leviste, will be filed before the Sandiganbayan soon as the complaint undergoes preliminary investigation, Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla said.

items.title: VP: Tackle SALN issues in court, before ombudsman
items.description: Vice President Sara Duterte on Thursday said the Senate impeachment court and the Office of the Ombudsman are the proper forums to answer allegations that she failed to declare properties linked to her family.

items.title: 60 percent think some senators won’t be fair in impeachment trial
items.description: While there will be some senators who will be impartial, a majority of Filipinos believed that there will be some who would not be fair in their decision in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, a survey conducted by Pulse Asia showed.
